analysis: The changed hunk in docs/provider/cli-reference.md (line ~2183, outside the two supplied excerpts) only extends the `[backend] enabled_models` description: when set, it also bounds coordinator model commands and rollouts. This is a documentation-only change with no code, config parsing, protocol, or enforcement changes. I examined the two supplied head_text units (lines 386-1226), which are unchanged surrounding documentation covering logout/revocation (A-008, T-053), the sandbox installer (TB-013, T-061), the add-on hold (TB-012, T-059/T-060), App Attest enrollment (TB-011), and the prefix cache (T-041). None of these is modified by the PR, so nothing in them is a new regression. The doc claims that the operator filter bounds coordinator commands. That claim is a security-relevant contract, because it narrows what a coordinator can push to a provider. The enforcement code and the linked configuration.md#provider-model-selection anchor are not in the supplied evidence, so I cannot confirm the behavior matches. This is an unverified contract rather than a finding, and the doc change does not weaken any control. The threat model has no gap forced by this PR. A later pass could verify that the provider code enforces enabled_models against coordinator model commands and rollouts (ProviderModelSelection and autopilot/model-command handling).
